code.r:
result = jp_solar %>%
  arrange(muni_code, date) %>%
  group_by(muni_code) %>%
  reframe(stat = c("min", "mean", "max"),
          solar = c(min(solar), mean(solar), max(solar)))
code.sql:
SELECT muni_code, 'min' AS stat, MIN(solar) AS solar FROM jp_solar
GROUP BY muni_code
UNION ALL
SELECT muni_code, 'mean', AVG(solar) FROM jp_solar
GROUP BY muni_code
UNION ALL
SELECT muni_code, 'max', MAX(solar) FROM jp_solar
GROUP BY muni_code;

code.r:
result = jp_solar %>%
  arrange(muni_code, date) %>%
  group_by(muni_code) %>%
  mutate(solar_lag = lag(solar, n = 1)) %>%
  ungroup()
code.sql:
SELECT *,
  LAG(solar, 1) OVER w AS solar_lag
FROM jp_solar
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY muni_code ORDER BY date);

code.r:
result = jp_solar %>%
  arrange(muni_code, date) %>%
  group_by(muni_code) %>%
  mutate(solar_roll3 = (solar + lag(solar, n = 1) + lag(solar, n = 2)) / 3) %>%
  ungroup()
code.sql:
SELECT *,
  (solar + LAG(solar, 1) OVER w + LAG(solar, 2) OVER w) / 3.0 AS solar_roll3
FROM jp_solar
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY muni_code ORDER BY date);
